summary: Provides the core orchestration, project configuration, workspace management, path utilities, snapshot analysis, and error handling for Python source code analysis.
responsibilities: Orchestrate Python source code analysis and workspace initialization.
Manage project configuration settings, metadata, and workspace definitions.
Provide path conversion and manipulation between various formats.
Manage project snapshots, change analysis, and difference computation.
Define custom error types and analysis phases for Python analysis operations.
relationships: Analysis orchestration utilizes project and workspace configurations, path conversion utilities, and snapshot management.
Project change analysis and snapshot management interact with project configuration and path structures.
design_decisions: Modular organization across core analysis, error handling, path utilities, project management, and snapshots.
Object-oriented encapsulation of project and workspace configurations.
